description: The three noise volumes the game's clouds read (MyPlanetEngine/Clouds.hlsli, t24 to t26). Headerless RGBA8, mip-major, x fastest. Licence: NOTICE. Their weather map, t27, is no longer an asset: the engine computes it at startup from the planet's climate (Climate::Weather, MyPlanetEngine/Climate.cpp; docs/spec-nuages.md, the weather).

shape128.rgba8mips.role: the low clouds' shape (R) and the cirrus' fibres (G); 128^3, 8 mips
shape128.rgba8mips.made_by: R, B and A: the Perlin-Worley shape noise of TileableVolumeNoise (commit 1f879a26, main.cpp unchanged), compiled and converted by tools/gen_frostbite_reference_assets.py; G: sparse cirrus fibres, tools/gen_frostbite_orbit_assets.py

detail32.rgba8mips.made_by: the Worley erosion noise of TileableVolumeNoise (commit 1f879a26), by tools/gen_frostbite_reference_assets.py

weather64.rgba8mips.role: the vertical profiles by cloud kind and height (RG); 64^3, 7 mips

former_weather_map: assets/clouds/weather-planet1024.rgba8mips and tools/gen_cloud_weather.py until the commit before piste/nuages-climat; an artistic noise field, kept in git's history.
